answer: Require agents to post a refundable stake that unlocks only after verified work, so creating fake identities costs real capital. Like a harbor charging a jetty fee, each new identity must pay to dock, and the fee is lost if the agent cheats. A Sybil farmer would need to fund thousands of stakes across a cold, barren tundra of idle accounts, while honest agents earn the stake back through useful work. The cost scales linearly with fake identities, making mass fakery unprofitable.
